# `SettleDone`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

End of a settle phase, successful or failed, with frame counts.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | event (device sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER (observation only) |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, socket_json_guider_server_event::NotifySettleDone @0x6df30 (64-bit guider build); 32-bit counterpart present |

Sent when the guide controller finishes settling, on success or failure; one per settle phase is expected (INFERRED), not guaranteed. Status 0 is success; any nonzero value is the failure branch, which adds Error when the message is nonempty. The imager's legacy Dither and Settle workflows wait for this event. Sent by the guider process (zwoair_guider) on its TCP 4400 event server to every retained connection (G/all). The main imager process, which is a client of 4400, recognises event lines and forwards them unchanged onto TCP 4700 (I/all), so 4700 clients also receive it; the auxiliary imager process deliberately does not forward 4400 events. The imager's forwarding test is lexical (the exact text "Event":" in the line). Custom guider producer: there is no lowercase state, code or error member; member names are capitalised as shown and capitalisation is wire-significant. No Android app consumer is established for this name; the imager's peer-event waiter may consume it. Ordering against RPC replies and other guider events is not guaranteed; no sequence number, replay or fixed cadence exists. Runtime reachability of the retained guiding functionality on every model is unresolved.

Side effects: Observation only for the receiver.

## Request params

None. Events are sent by the device without a request; the payload is below.

## Payload

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Event` | string | yes | - | Discriminator. Fixed value `"SettleDone"`. [READ] |
| `Timestamp` | string | yes | - | Decimal string <seconds>.<nine digits> from clock id 1 (monotonic, INFERRED); not a calendar time. [READ] |
| `Status` | integer | yes | - | 0 success; nonzero failure branch. Nonzero values are not enumerated. [READ] |
| `Error` | string | if Status is nonzero and the error text is nonempty | - | Failure message. [READ] |
| `TotalFrames` | integer | yes | - | Frames taken during settling. [READ] |
| `DroppedFrames` | integer | yes | - | Frames dropped during settling. [READ] |

## Errors

None. Failures appear in the payload (`code`, `error`) when `state` is `fail`.

## Example

Event, success - Static example (READ shape, not captured; values invented):

```json
{"Event":"SettleDone","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","Status":0,"TotalFrames":6,"DroppedFrames":0}
```

Event, failure - Static example of the failure branch (READ shape, not captured; values and text invented):

```json
{"Event":"SettleDone","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","Status":1,"Error":"example settle failure text","TotalFrames":30,"DroppedFrames":4}
```
